adjudication.PASS: only if every required inequality is proved uniformly for all M>=521 and all real s in the interval
adjudication.REFUTED: one exact counterexample to any claimed universal tail inequality
adjudication.INCONCLUSIVE: an unclosed remainder, numerical trend, or finite-only confirmation
